info.name: 3PL Warehouse Manager (SecureWMS) REST Authentication Customers API

params.name: rql
params.description: Resource Query Language filter, e.g. "readonly.lastModifiedDate=ge=2024-01-01". Reference http://api.3plcentral.com/rels/rql.

params.name: sort
params.description: Field to sort by, e.g. ReadOnly.lastModifiedDate or receivedDate.

items.docs: Lists the customers (merchants) configured in the warehouse. Paged with pgnum/pgsiz, filterable with rql, sortable (e.g. ReadOnly.CreationDate). CONFIRMED (GET /customers).
